historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGRs (26.2% 3yr, 22.5% 5yr) and total-income CAGRs (24.3% / 20.4%) are inflated by the July-2023 reverse merger with HDFC Ltd (total assets ~Rs 24.7trn -> ~36.2trn; share count +36%) and diverge >30% from EPS (7.1% 3yr). They are a one-time step, not organic growth. The selected anchor is post-merger only: BVPS FY24-FY26 +12.3%/yr; underlying net revenue FY25-FY26 +8.2%; EPS FY24-FY26 +6.4%/yr.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF CAGRs are not computed: a bank's reported OCF/FCF is dominated by deposit, loan and investment flows (FY19 -576bn, FY25 +1,420bn) and is not owner earnings. Revenue CAGRs are on total income (interest earned + other income) from the CSV; the model's revenue line is net revenue. EPS and BVPS in the CSV are restated for the Aug-2025 1:1 bonus. ROE 16.4-18.0% pre-merger (FY17-FY24) vs 14.3% / 14.0% FY25 / FY26 post-merger.

scenario_narratives.base: Merger digestion continues slowly: FY27 net revenue +7%, loan growth converging on system ~12%; partial NIM recovery offset by normalising credit costs, so ROE holds ~14% (FY26 14.0%). Growth fades to 7% by year 10 and 6.5% nominal INR thereafter. Subsidiary stakes add ~Rs 91/share after a 20% holdco discount.
scenario_narratives.bull: New CEO executes: CASA back toward 38%, NIM +40-50bps as HDFC Ltd-era borrowings mature, 13-14% loan growth for five years; ROE ~16%, CAR run down modestly toward ~17.5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: CASA and NIM dilution prove permanent, credit costs rise through the ECL transition, growth 7-9%; ROE ~12.5% = cost of equity, value ~book plus subsidiaries.

valuation_philosophy.summary: HDFC Bank is valued as a bank: FCFE (standalone net profit less the book equity retained to grow the balance sheet at today's capital ratio) discounted at a 12.5% INR cost of equity, deposits and borrowings treated as operating funding (net debt = 0), plus the listed and unlisted subsidiary stakes at market less a 20% holdco discount. The judgment that matters is ROE versus cost of equity versus growth. Post-merger ROE is ~14% against a 12.5% CoE, so the standalone bank earns a modest spread and is worth roughly 1.3-1.5x book in the base case; the market price (~2.1x standalone book, ~1.85x after stripping subsidiaries) is discounting either a recovery to pre-merger 16.5-18% ROE or a cost of equity nearer 10-11%.
key_risks_to_valuation: NIM/CASA recovery: each 1pp of PBT-to-net-revenue margin is ~Rs 14bn of profit (~2% of value); the bear path makes the HDFC Ltd margin dilution permanent, the bull path delivers management's 40-50bps NIM guidance.
Cost of equity: the valuation is long-duration (growth near CoE for five years). At 11% the base case rises materially; see required_return_table and the sensitivity grid.
CEO transition: Anup Bagchi took over 27-Oct-2026 from outside the bank; no strategy update yet.
Capital/regulation: E/R held constant (CAR ~18.9%); the April-2027 ECL transition, RBI risk weights on unsecured retail or PSL shortfall purchases would raise retention or costs.
Subsidiary values are marked to 6-Nov-2026 market prices (~Rs 91/share after discount, ~12% of IV); HDFC Life and AMC trade near 52-week lows/mid-range and move the bridge directly.

Basis: Indian GAAP standalone. One-offs normalised out of FY0 (HDBFS OFS gain Rs 9,128 crore pre-tax, floating provision Rs 9,000 crore); they roughly offset, so the FY0 profit anchor is ~3% below reported.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 669.20-1,017.50. Subsidiary prices (HDFCLIFE.NS, HDFCAMC.NS, HDBFS.NS) from the same API at the same close.
data_sources.financials: HDFCBANK.NS_Metrics.csv / core_metrics and kpis (Indian GAAP standalone, INR millions, FY2016-Q2 FY2027); Q2 FY2027 standalone results (HDFCBANK.NS_Quarterly_Q2-FY2027.txt lines 8-40, 160-180) for the H1 FY27 P&L, Sep-26 net worth and share capital; Q1 FY2026 results notes 6 and 9 for the HDBFS OFS gain and the floating provision; FY2026 annual report lines 18172-18180 and 29969-29982 for subsidiary holdings, net assets and profit.
data_sources.qualitative: HDFCBANK.NS_Analysis.json (2026-11-08): CASA/NIM trend and guidance, CEO transition, Q2 FY27 results, RBI risk-weight/PSL threads. Cross-reference: research/HDB/Reports/HDB_Drivers.json (ADR model of the same bank, 2026-10-04).

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted equity shares 15,467.6m = 15,418.6m issued at 2026-09-30 (paid-up capital Rs 1,541.86 crore at Rs 1 face value, Q2 FY2027 standalone results line 15; post the 1:1 bonus of Aug-2025) + ~49m treasury-method ESOS/ESIS dilution (FY26 diluted less basic weighted shares, same figure the HDB ADR model uses). Held flat: SBC (ESOS/ESIS fair value) is expensed inside employee cost under Indian GAAP, so option exercises (~60-110m shares a year) are not also modelled as dilution. No buybacks (Indian banks do not repurchase).
inputs.sbc_source: HDFCBANK.NS_Metrics.csv StockBasedComp FY2026 Rs 19,710.7m (FY25 18,907.0m, FY24 15,474.0m), from the standalone cash flow statement add-back. ESOS/ESIS settle in new shares; no net-share-settlement tax line exists, EquityAwardTaxes = 0.
inputs.fcf_definition: Bank FCFE, not owner FCF. last_fcf = FY2026 UNDERLYING standalone net profit (Rs 722.4bn = underlying PBT 950.4bn x (1 - 24%); reported PAT 746.7bn less the post-tax effect of the HDB Financial Services OFS gain and the Rs 9,000 crore floating provision, which roughly offset pre-tax) less the book-equity retention needed to fund FY26 net-revenue growth of 8.2% at the FY0 equity/net-revenue ratio of 3.07 (3.07 x Rs 137.9bn = 426bn) = Rs 296bn. reported_fcf adds SBC back (street basis). Actual dividends paid FY26 Rs 207.1bn (28% payout). Interest income is the bank's revenue, not a return on excess cash, so interest_income = 0.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-06T09:59:13Z regular close (NSE; 7-8 Nov is a weekend)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Single INR cost of equity 12.5% across all scenarios (risk charged once, through the scenario weights), identical to the HDB ADR model of the same bank so the two listings stay comparable. Built in the flows' own currency: India 10-year G-sec ~6.4-6.5% + beta ~0.85-0.9 x India total equity risk premium ~6.5-7.0% (mature-market ~4.3% plus India country premium) = ~12.0-12.8%; Indian brokers use 12-13% for large private banks. A lower 11-12% CoE is arguable for India's highest-quality lender (beta has run nearer 0.8 recently); the required_return_table shows what it is worth.
inputs.lease_treatment: Bank: rent sits in other operating expenses, i.e. inside PBT. No separate lease line; lease_cost_pct_path = 0.
inputs.nci_treatment: Standalone accounts, so no NCI inside the flow. Subsidiaries (HDFC Life 50.21%, HDFC AMC 52.37%, HDB Financial 74.12%, HDFC ERGO 50.33%, HDFC Securities 94.01%) are added once, in equity_bridge, at the bank's share of market value (or a book/earnings multiple for the unlisted two) less a 20% holdco discount. Standalone revenue carries the dividends those subsidiaries pay up (~Rs 15-18bn a year, ~2% of profit); the holdco discount more than covers that overlap.
inputs.notes: MODEL: bank -> dcf-methods routing row 'Bank, non-bank deposit taker'. Run as FCFE at cost of equity through the component engine, the house precedent for banks (HDB, IBN, USB, WFC, TFC, NAB.AX) and the same structure as the HDB ADR model of this bank; with retention tied to book equity, FCFE-at-CoE is the residual-income model on book (clean surplus). BASIS: Indian GAAP STANDALONE (the CSV/core_metrics basis). The July-2023 HDFC Ltd merger was pooled under Indian GAAP, so standalone book carries no merger goodwill and is effectively tangible (BVPS Rs 365.68 at FY26, ~Rs 375.6 at Sep-26 ex ESOP reserve); the HDB model uses US GAAP TCE (Rs 337/share) and revenue incl. insurance premia, so its margin/E-R ratios differ but the economics are the same. ENGINE MAPPING: revenue = net revenue = net interest income + other income, EXCLUDING the Rs 9,128 crore pre-tax HDB Financial Services OFS gain booked in Q1 FY26 (FY26: NII 1,286,860 + other income 625,326 - 91,280 = Rs 1,820,906m). Gross interest earned is not used because it moves with the rate cycle on both sides of the spread. 'ebitda' = PBT + SBC, with PBT underlying = reported 951,687 - OFS gain 91,280 + Rs 9,000 crore floating provision 90,000 = 950,407 -> (950,407 + 19,711)/1,820,906 = 53.3%. sbc_pct 1.08%. da_pct 0 (bank D&A, Rs 36.6bn, is an operating expense already inside PBT; branch/IT capex treated as maintenance inside it). 'capex' = book-equity retention required to grow the balance sheet = E/R x g/(1+g) with E/R = FY26 net worth (capital 1,539.34 + reserves 556,816.45 crore = Rs 5,583,558m, ESOP reserve excluded) / underlying net revenue = 3.07. Holding E/R constant keeps CAR near today's 18.9% (CET1 ~16.5-17%, minimum 8.4% incl. 0.4% D-SIB surcharge and CCB) through the April-2027 ECL transition; no excess capital is released into the bridge in base/bear. FY0 check: (53.3 - 1.08)% x (1 - 0.24) x 1,820,906 = Rs 722bn underlying PAT; Y1 (FY27E) PAT ~Rs 780bn vs H1 FY27 actual Rs 386.7bn. Implied ROE on opening book: ~13.9% FY27E base, ~14.2% steady state base, ~16.3% bull, ~12.6% bear (= CoE). net_debt = 0: deposits (Rs 33.3trn at Sep-26) and borrowings (Rs 4.89trn) are operating funding; their interest is already in NII. YEAR-1 EVIDENCE: H1 FY27 (Apr-Sep 2026) net revenue Rs 948.1bn vs H1 FY26 Rs 899.4bn ex-OFS gain (+5.4%), NII +8.2% (Q2 +9.7%), other income flat (treasury gains Rs 780 crore vs 2,390 crore), opex +4.9%, provisions Rs 6,633 crore (~0.45% annualised credit cost), PBT Rs 51,018 crore = 53.8% of net revenue, tax 24.4%. CASA ~32% (Q1 FY27), NIM compressed ~12bps QoQ in Q1 FY27 (Analysis.json); CASA ratio and NIM are not stored in core_metrics. Subsidiary share counts used in equity_bridge (HDFC Life ~2,155m, HDFC AMC ~427.8m post 1:1 bonus, HDB Financial ~829.4m post IPO) are from exchange disclosures, not the extracted filings; HDBFS ties exactly to the 94.32% -> 74.19% dilution in the Q1 FY26 note 6.

bear.capex_rationale: Book-equity retention = 307 x g/(1+g) (E/R 3.07 held constant).
bear.narrative: Merger margin dilution is structural: CASA stuck in the low 30s against PSU-bank and small-savings deposit competition, repo cuts keep compressing yields faster than deposit costs, unsecured retail credit costs normalise upward through the ECL transition, and the leadership change slows execution. Loan growth 7-9% (at or below system); margin slides to 49%, ROE ~12.5%, equal to the cost of equity, so the bank is worth about book plus subsidiaries.

base.capex_rationale: Book-equity retention = 307 x g/(1+g) percent of revenue (equity/net revenue 3.07 held constant, CAR ~18-19%).
base.cash_tax_rate_note: H1 FY27 effective 24.4%; statutory 25.17%; FY26 21.5% was flattered by the lower-taxed OFS capital gain.
base.narrative: FY27 net revenue +7% (H1 +5.4% ex the OFS gain, NII accelerating to +9.7% in Q2), then loan growth converges on system at ~12% as the credit-deposit ratio (94.6%) normalises. NIM recovery from legacy HDFC Ltd borrowings rolling off is real but partial and is largely absorbed by credit costs normalising from today's ~0.45% toward 0.6-0.7% and the ECL transition; cost-to-income edges down from 38%. PBT-to-net-revenue holds ~53.5-54.5%, ROE ~14% (about today's). Growth fades to 7% by year 10, 6.5% nominal INR in perpetuity.

bull.capex_rationale: Book-equity retention = 292 x g/(1+g): equity/net revenue allowed to drift 5% lower (CAR ~18.9% -> ~17.5%, still far above the ~12% minimum).
bull.narrative: Anup Bagchi's cross-sell playbook from the ICICI group lands: CASA rebuilds from ~32% toward management's 38% target, legacy borrowings roll off and NIM recovers the guided 40-50bps, loan growth runs 13-14% (above system) for five years. Margin reaches 59% of net revenue, ROE ~16%, approaching the 16.5-18% pre-merger range.

entry_price.hurdle_note: 15% applied to INR flows; with INR depreciating ~3%/yr against USD over the long run, a 15% INR IRR is roughly 12% in USD.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Same 25/50/25 as the HDB ADR model (2026-10-04) so the two listings stay comparable. Bear held above the house 15%: management's CASA/NIM recovery has slipped for three years, Q1 FY27 NIM compressed again, Q2 FY27 missed on treasury and provisions, and Anup Bagchi (external hire, started 27-Oct-2026) has not yet set out a strategy. The successor being named and RBI-approved removes one HDB-era risk, but not enough to move weights before he has reported. Bull 25%: needs several independent things (CASA rebuild, NIM recovery, above-system growth). Base 50%: asset quality is clean (GNPA 1.11%, NNPA 0.37% at Sep-26), capital ample (CAR 18.87%).

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
